decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has kept its own dedicated page for two years, which signals results at or above aspiration in a growing industry, so management has no shortfall to trigger a search for alternatives.

The hyaluronic serum is still listed and sits close to the core offer, so it costs little to carry, though its modest web presence suggests only satisfactory results that a small firm with limited slack might review.

The cleansing oil is newly launched and has had little time to be judged against aspiration, and it may be replacing the discontinued cleansing milk, so management is likely to keep it while results remain uncertain.
